status: preregistered; run only after the full-train heatmap archive passes completion gates
interpretation: exploratory new-observation test after CSC-L8-v1 A2 was observed to fail; not an untouched confirmation
target: the already frozen three T=1 JS semantic-curvature scores per valid CSC-L8 block
folds: the exact five source-disjoint folds and 578-source grouping carried by the CSC-L8 target archive
visible_time: decision_arrival plus bounded L8 offset; no future continuation, reference, reward, WER, or true EOS

features.K: unchanged 68-D causal pose/hand/motion history summary from CSC-L8-v1 A2
features.U_history: 31 frames ending at the bounded-L8 visible time; repeat frame zero at the left boundary
features.U_projection: fixed signed feature-hash projection 384 to 64, seed 261121, shared across folds; no target fitting
features.normalization: outer-train mean and standard deviation only

model.type: three-output closed-form ridge with unpenalized intercept

primary_gates.decision: all five gates must pass before any policy outcome or closed-loop evaluation

forbidden: changing U groups, quantities, pooling, history, projection, ridge alpha, or gates after extraction
selecting between U and K+U after outcomes
reading robust reward, terminal advantage, reference, WER, future continuation, or true EOS
formal policy OOF or closed loop before all primary gates pass
